title: Norwegian Occipital Ischemic Stroke Study
brief_summary: Patients who suffer an ischemic stroke in the occipital lobe often experience Visual Field defects. Visual Field defects are negatively correlated to falling, institutionalisation, rehabilitation outcome and quality of life. Patients are often not properly examined and seldom receive rehabilitation. NOR-OCCIP aims to evaluate the Natural history of Visual Field defects after occipital infarction and to determine whether rehabilitation is effective.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Written consent obtained,
* age \>18,
* acute occipital infarction on brain imaging and ability to cooperate for examination with autoperimetry

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pathological processes that severely affect eyesight.
